# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [66437553eaf415be3bc91171ba8d1ededd97d3c9](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/66437553eaf415be3bc91171ba8d1ededd97d3c9).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree d84b0a6cb1117ce5adbcc4571caa729a143ba3f8).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
